page.title: Find help by need
page.description: Social and medico-social needs, with the checked information pages and the support centres published for Strasbourg and the Bas-Rhin.
page.intro: Choose what applies to you. Only checked information pages and published places are shown: if a need has no page yet, this is clearly stated.
emergency.title: In an emergency or if you are in danger
emergency.intro: These official numbers are free. AccesDirectAide cannot itself step in during an emergency.
none: No checked information page for this need yet. A social support centre (CCAS, Maison des solidarités, France Services) can guide you.
note: This list of needs follows the official classifications of the social and medico-social sector. It does not mean that any benefit is owed to you: only the organisation concerned decides.
